candidate.name: ProtectedCausalGraphBank
candidate.structure: Each slot has a public-data mismatch vector over 45 XOR/AND/OR pair hypotheses of 6 public inputs for m0; 45 for m1; 84 over unordered two of (6 inputs, observed m0,m1) for m2; per-output MAP smallest mismatch + prior penalty with index tie break. No raw episode history in a slot.
candidate.graph_prediction: At an unobserved intervention input x, compute m0/m1 MAP bits then compute m2 MAP bit using those two predicted mediator bits; return 0.9 for predicted 1 else 0.1, per bit; same prediction for candidate and all structure-matched controls.
candidate.public_update: Observations only x six bits, mediators three bits, goal, actual reward, actions_taken; each new actual public state adds 3*45/84 mismatch counts to slot, with m2 hypotheses evaluated using OBSERVED m0,m1 for truthful structural fitting; no simulator law labels or unchosen action outcome.
candidate.recall: After two PUBLIC observation rows, compare exact 6 public mediator bits of batch against each existing slot's current MAP structural graph (m2 evaluated with OBSERVED upstream mediators); if best inactive slot errors <= active errors-2, recall lowest-error inactive slot (tie smallest slot ID).
candidate.novelty: Only if no recall, current active errors>=3/6, current active slot has >=8 public rows and an unused slot exists: allocate a slot with 1-unit mismatch-equivalent operator penalty for m0,m1,m2 rules whose operation differs from oldest protected slot with >=8 rows; no phase ID or hidden label. Else update active.
candidate.saturation: Never allow >96 rows in any slot; fail closed before state mutation if selected slot+2>96. No implicit eviction, truncation, rehearsal or silent forgetting.
candidate.planner: Exactly original AAI-11P controls.plan (same shared public state, STOP, deterministic two actual interventions); prediction cache invalidates after any learned batch. No other planner customization.
candidate.cold: Exact canonical JSON sorted deterministic serialization, strict restore validation of slot counters, scratch, IDs and prior weights; ephemeral caches never serialized.
candidate.one_slot: Same exact candidate with max_slots=1, no operator prior, same public budget <=64+8+3=75 rows, zero protected slots; both use identical planner.

matched_structural_controls.graph_recent8: Same 45/45/84 public grammar and same MAP prediction/policy, sliding last 8 real public rows; exact sufficient statistic add/subtract and fully updated on all observed rows.
matched_structural_controls.graph_recent16: Same graph grammar/predictor/policy, last 16 public rows.
matched_structural_controls.graph_all: Same graph grammar/predictor/policy, all public rows; no regime segmentation or protected slot history.

fairness.same_observations: ALL 11 matched controls, candidate, one-slot ablation, and original reactive diagnostic get exactly the same 64 public A/B pre/post states plus 2/4 public do-action challenge trials for a given fixture; the same 0-2 real action allowance and actual feedback per method. No phase/regime ID, simulator formula, reward of unchosen action or oracle leak.
fairness.train: 16 one-action A trials and 16 one-action B trials (64 public rows) identical to original AAI-11P admission fixture generator; boundaries private.
fairness.challenge: 2 and 4 exogenous one-action trials per law, 4/8 public rows; original A/B training checkpoint cold restored independently per C/D/E/F unfamiliar phase and A-return/B-hold diagnostics.
fairness.eval: 12 unique (x,goal) contexts per law from original AAI11P admission; independent cold restore for each method/condition/context, each may learn only its own actual consequence; evaluate terminal public reward and exactly correct three-goal success; same planner
fairness.strongest_selection: Select maximum mean terminal reward over all 11 trained conventional matched eligible controls, not convenient original symbolic_recent16 alone; actual-law oracle is diagnostic excluded.
fairness.negative: handcrafted synthetic public post-action mediator exchange across distinct challenge x, preserved x/action and mediator marginal frequencies; recomputed public reward, never an alternative physically coherent law; evaluation actual simulator remains true. Must not interpret negative as independent science.
fairness.future_science: AAI-11P reserved 994000..994015 DEV, 995000..995063 TRANSFER, 996000..996031 NEGATIVE remain unused; do not generate or touch these here.

dev_fixture_gate.admit_only_if: Candidate vs strongest of 11 fully trained controls on 3 synthetic fixtures across four novel C/D/E/F laws at N=2,4 with 12 independent contexts each >=+0.08 terminal reward AND headroom known-law oracle vs strongest >=+0.25. Also candidate vs full-budget 1slot >=+0.05, unfamiliar three-goal success >=0.60; A/B retention floor candidate >= strongest-0.03. These are development ADMISSION thresholds only, not independent science CIs; any fail is recorded as candidate DEV_NO_GO, no post-result tuning or reuse of science cohorts.
dev_fixture_gate.cost: Record candidate and every matched total train+checkpoint+challenge+action+restore walltime, serialized bytes; require candidate <=2.0x fastest matched whole process and no new native changes; if not measured or failed, no science first-use.
dev_fixture_gate.mechanical_negative: Private-field rejection, no hidden law or oracle, legal do-actions only, no shared episode training, protected inactive slots never modified by active slot updates, single-slot cap no unfair abort, complete source-custody and exact cold restoration.
dev_fixture_gate.full_regression: Final exact candidate SHA both Linux/Windows full native 54+ focused benchmark 10+ new tests and G29 generated code atlas source-pinned; no alternative runner or scheduler.
